name: Melanie Stansbury
role: US representative for New Mexico’s First District since 2021; former state legislator and environmental-policy analyst
summary: Stansbury advocates expanded public services, civil rights, climate regulation and tribal self-determination. Her public-safety approach combines community investment and police accountability with additional staffing; her foreign-policy statements distinguish support for allies from offensive wars.
